summary: First-finish smoke test on TutorHive: verified backend auth + tutor search + booking + double-booking prevention + admin + notifications + role guards, plus UI smoke test for landing, tutor search, and student login. Core P0 flows work; found one HIGH backend bug in review endpoint (500 due to ObjectId serialization) and one MEDIUM UI/data bug on student dashboard.
passed: POST /api/auth/login for student/tutor/admin all 200 with correct roles
POST /api/bookings creates booking (200) with CONFIRMED status, price/fees computed
Double-booking prevention: second POST to same tutor_id+start_time returns 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE (both same-user and cross-user)
GET /api/tutors/{id}/slots?date=... correctly marks booked=true for taken slots
Landing page renders hero + CTA + navigation
Student login redirects to /student/dashboard with correct testids

failed.issue: POST /api/bookings/{id}/review returns HTTP 500. Review IS persisted (retry returns 400 'Review already submitted' and review appears in GET /api/tutors/{id}.reviews list), but response serialization crashes with: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]. Client sees 500 for a successful action.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/bookings/543d9e06-.../review -> HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Backend log stack trace from fastapi.encoders.jsonable_encoder. Retry POST -> 400 'Review already submitted'. GET /api/tutors/548c0252-.../reviews list length=1.

failed.issue: GET /api/tutors/{id} returns rating_avg=null and total_reviews=null (not aggregated/updated after review). Reviews list is populated but summary fields are missing/None. Frontend TutorProfile relies on these.
failed.evidence: curl GET /api/tutors/548c0252-... -> rating: None, reviews: None, reviews_list length: 1

failed.issue: Student dashboard shows '0 upcoming' and 'No upcoming sessions' / 'No past sessions yet.' even though the authenticated student has 2 bookings (1 CONFIRMED, 1 COMPLETED). Possible mismatch between dashboard aggregation query and bookings list.
failed.evidence: Screenshot of /student/dashboard after login; GET /api/bookings returns bookings but dashboard counters/lists show empty.

failed.issue: GET /api/tutors/me/availability for demo tutor returns {"slots": []} despite slots endpoint deriving 4 valid slots per day (Mon-Thu 17-21 UTC). Availability document appears not seeded in the shape the me/availability endpoint expects, OR the endpoint reads a different key. Not blocking booking (slots endpoint works), but tutor cannot edit availability from UI without initial data.
failed.evidence: curl -b tutor.cookies GET /api/tutors/me/availability -> {"slots": []}, but GET /api/tutors/{demo}/slots?date=2026-09-14 -> 4 slots.

action_items: Fix review endpoint 500: exclude Mongo _id from response or return a plain dict/Pydantic model (likely returning the raw insert result including ObjectId in POST /api/bookings/{id}/review).
After review submission, aggregate rating_avg/total_reviews on tutor profile and include them in GET /api/tutors/{id}.
Investigate student dashboard aggregation: ensure it queries the same collection with matching student_id and shows CONFIRMED as upcoming.
Seed demo tutor availability slots (or ensure GET /api/tutors/me/availability derives from same source as /slots) so tutor UI shows current weekly availability.
